extractor_mismatch_note: The served per-arm changes, SDs and sample sizes agree with the source, but the analysis_set label 'completers efficacy set' conflicts with the reported FAS subgroup and registry designation of a pre-planned ITT analysis aged 65-80. The reported adjusted between-arm effect is -15.6 minutes; subtracting the served arm changes gives an unadjusted difference of -17.4 minutes, which is not the estimate associated with the reported confidence interval. The estimate applies at 3 weeks, not the end of the 26-week extension.
